description: This PHP source file defines the Approval class within the Opencart\Catalog\Model\Account namespace. The class provides methods to add and delete customer approval records in the database, facilitating approval management for customer accounts.

classes.name: Approval
classes.description: A model class that manages customer approval records, including adding new approvals and deleting existing approvals from the database.

methods.name: addApproval
methods.description: Creates a new customer approval record in the database with specified customer ID and approval type.

methods.name: deleteApprovals
methods.description: Deletes all approval records associated with a given customer ID from the database.
